description: Land Acquisition - Katubedda, Moratuwa D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette notice is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, providing detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired by the government for development projects. It contains no government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories. The content focuses entirely on land matters including property descriptions, boundaries, claimants, and acquisition procedures, making it a clear Land Gazette (Type 4).
